full.description: This is a microscopic view of lung pleura tissue stained with hematoxylin and eosin. The image displays a reaction to talc, which is often used therapeutically to sclerose the pleura in emphysematous lung conditions. Prominent features include foreign body reactions with associated fibrosis and inflammation in the pleural space. The pathological findings are characteristic of a talc pleurodesis or talc reaction.
